objects.description: Publisher of the Top Level Cyber Threat Clusters (TLCTC) framework, v2.6. https://www.tlctc.net

objects.name: TLCTC for Attack Flow
objects.description: Adds TLCTC v2.6 cause classification to Attack Flow objects: on attack-action the cause cluster (#1..#10) of the step, its operational sub-cluster, the attack velocity to the next step, responsibility-sphere and intra-system boundaries, Data Risk Events, foreign-code execution and the unresolved state; on attack-flow the path-level metadata and notation; on attack-operator the parallel-group metadata. Attack Flow says what the adversary did; this extension says which generic vulnerability each step exploited.
